title: Find a No Interest Loans Scheme (NILS) provider
summary: Find information about the No Interest Loans Scheme (NILS) and locate a local provider for safe and affordable credit.
intro:
The No Interest Loans Scheme (NILS) offers safe and affordable access to credit to people on low incomes in NSW.

Note: The dollar amounts on this page refer to Australian Dollar.

### What you need to know
who_can_apply: Have a health care card or pension card.
Have experienced family or domestic violence in the last 10 years.
Live at your current address for a minimum of 3 months.
Show that you are able to repay the loan in the given time period.
what_you_need: Contact your local NILS provider or call Good Shepherd on 13 64 57.
contact: Contact your local NILS provider or call Good Shepherd on 13 64 57.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for NILS?
faqs.a: You may be eligible if you have a health care card or pension card, have experienced family or domestic violence in the last 10 years, or meet specific earnings criteria.

faqs.q: What types of items can NILS loans cover?
faqs.a: Credit can be available for whitegoods, essential household furniture, educational necessities (like computers and textbooks), some medical and dental services, car repairs, and bond for a new property.

faqs.q: How do I find a NILS provider?
faqs.a: You can contact your local NILS provider or call Good Shepherd on 13 64 57.
